Generate a self-signed certificate for a Quack server

Source: R/quack.R
quack_generate_keys.Rd

Writes server.pem and private_key.pem for quack_serve() to serve HTTPS with, and returns their paths with the certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint, which clients pass as ssl_fingerprint to attach_quack() or quack_query() so they can trust the self-signed certificate. Existing key files are not overwritten.

Usage

quack_generate_keys(directory = NULL)

Arguments

directory

Directory to write the files into. NULL (the default) uses DuckDB's own location, ~/.duckdb/extension_data/quack.

Value

A data frame with one row: cert_file, key_file, fingerprint, and status.

See also

quack_serve()

Other quack: attach_quack(), detach_quack(), install_quack(), quack_query(), quack_serve(), quack_stop()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
keys <- quack_generate_keys(directory = "~/quack-keys")
quack_serve(
  "quack:0.0.0.0:9494", token = "super_secret",
  allow_other_hostname = TRUE,
  ssl_cert_file = keys$cert_file, ssl_key_file = keys$key_file
)
# Clients pin the certificate:
# attach_quack("team", "quack:host:9494", token = "super_secret",
#              ssl_fingerprint = keys$fingerprint)
} # }
